Hi,
For the fixed difference analysis (gl.fixed.diff), in the documentation it says "NOTE: The above test will only be calculated if tloc=0, that is, for analyses of absolute fixed differences. The test applies in comparisons of allopatric populations only. For sympatric populations, use gl.pval.sympatry()."

I am unable to find anything on gl.pval.sympatry...does it exist? Is there a way to test for significance of tloc does not =0?

Thank you!
Nikki
